title: Complete or Sparse: A Tale of Two Identifiabilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.20851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding when neural networks learn interpretable representations is central to mechanistic interpretability. We study this through identifiability: when can supervised learning recover the true latent variables underlying the data? We introduce two data generating processes distinguished by their causal direction where either labels cause latents (generative) or latents cause labels (discriminative). When the representation has at least as many dimensions as the latent space, we prove that the optimal encoders are linear in the latents. Conversely, when dimensions are insufficient, identifiability generically fails and encoders become nonlinear. We then show that additional constraints yield recovery of individual latent variables, not just linear mixtures. In the generative setting, non-negative activations and energy efficiency force each neuron to encode exactly one latent, providing a precise account of selective grandmother

translated_title: 完整还是稀疏：两种可辨识性的故事
translated_abstract: 理解神经网络何时学习到可解释的表示，是机制可解释性研究的核心问题。我们通过可辨识性来研究这一问题：监督学习何时能够恢复数据背后真实的潜在变量？我们引入了两种以因果方向相区分的数据生成过程：一种是由标签导致潜在变量（生成式），另一种是由潜在变量导致标签（判别式）。当表示的维度不少于潜在空间的维度时，我们证明最优编码器是潜在变量的线性函数；相反，当维度不足时，可辨识性通常会失效，编码器变为非线性。随后我们进一步证明，额外的约束能够恢复单个潜在变量，而不仅仅是它们的线性混合。在生成式设定中，非负激活与能量效率迫使每个神经元恰好编码一个潜在变量，从而为“选择性祖母神经元”现象提供了精确的理论解释。
tldr: 本文证明在生成式与判别式两种因果方向下，表示维度充足时最优编码器是潜在变量的线性函数，而结合非负激活与能量效率约束可使每个神经元恰好编码一个潜在变量，为“祖母神经元”现象提供了精确的理论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that with sufficient representation dimensions, optimal encoders are linear in the latents under both generative and discriminative causal directions, and that non-negative activations combined with energy efficiency force each neuron to encode exactly one latent variable, providing a precise account of "grandmother neurons".
